title: RE-CAM: Readout-Enhanced Content-Addressable Memory for Quantitative Similarity Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.25326v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Similarity search is essential to many applications but incurs massive data movement when executed on conventional architectures. Content-addressable memory (CAM) is a promising hardware substrate, as it allows similarity search directly in the CAM array, minimizing data movement and offering both low latency and high energy efficiency. However, conventional CAM array readout produces only binary match results, discarding quantitative similarity information that could be further exploited. Extracting this information requires interpreting the CAM array output voltage that evolves during a CAM search, making the sensing timestamp a crucial design variable alongside the reference voltage and decoding parameter. In this work, we propose RE-CAM, a readout enhancement framework for CAM that is agnostic to memory technology and application, enabling CAM array readout to approximate linear and nonlinear functions with one CAM search. By reusi

translated_title: RE-CAM：面向定量相似性搜索的读出增强型内容寻址存储器
translated_abstract: 相似性搜索对许多应用至关重要，但在传统架构上执行时会产生大量的数据移动。内容寻址存储器（CAM）是一种有前景的硬件载体，因为它可以直接在CAM阵列内进行相似性搜索，最大限度地减少数据移动，同时提供低延迟和高能效。然而，传统的CAM阵列读出只能产生二进制的匹配结果，丢弃了可以进一步利用的定量相似性信息。提取这些信息需要解读CAM搜索过程中不断演变的阵列输出电压，这使得感知时间戳与参考电压和解码参数一起成为关键的设计变量。在这项工作中，我们提出了RE-CAM，一个与存储器技术和应用无关的CAM读出增强框架，使CAM阵列读出能够通过一次CAM搜索近似线性和非线性函数。
tldr: RE-CAM提出了一个与存储器技术和应用无关的读出增强框架，通过将感知时间戳作为关键设计变量，使CAM阵列在单次搜索中即可近似线性和非线性函数，将传统的二进制匹配读出升级为定量相似性搜索。
en_tdlr: RE-CAM proposes a memory-technology- and application-agnostic readout enhancement framework that leverages the sensing timestamp as a crucial design variable, enabling a single CAM search to approximate linear and nonlinear functions and upgrade conventional binary match readout to quantitative similarity search.
